meta.name: deltamere
meta.prompt: Build me Deltamere, a dense harbour-and-trade city sprawling over a river delta. I want a working waterfront: long piers with a whole fleet at anchor — a galleon, a caravel, a cog, a junk, a longship, barges, a paddle steamer, a ferry, tugs and trawlers and little rowboats — and a container ship out in the channel past the buoys. Behind the quays put a docklands of bonded warehouses, a customs house, a shipyard with its dry dock and a boathouse on the slip. Inland from that I want a packed market quarter with every trade under one roof: taverns, a brewery and a distillery, a spice souk, an arcade, a bank and a counting house, an auction house and a caravanserai. Up on the higher ground give the city a civic acropolis around a plaza — town hall, courthouse, university, hospital, museum, guildhall, mint and all the rest — with cobbled roads tying the three districts together and a lighthouse out on the headland.
